runners.title: 📅 Runners
runners.hint: Every name on Gajjala's scanner that ran. With no 🚩 A+ that session: a 09:30–20:00 ET high of +40% or more vs the prior close, the peak not premarket. With a 🚩 A+: a high of +30% or more above the A+ trigger after it rang, same session to 20:00 ET. Seated the next session, kept 10 sessions from the run day; a new qualifying day restarts the count. 🚫 names last. It leaves after day 10 or on its own ×. Tap a name for its chart, ➕ to watch it live. This list never rings. UNMEASURED. 2 ran but are not seated — tap for why. 1 not checked yet.
